topic: Divergence and Curl: Understanding Vector Fields

sections.title: Introduction: The Flow of a Fluid
lecture_lines: Vector fields assign vectors to space points.
Fluid flow serves as our core metaphor.
Velocity arrows illustrate direction and speed.
animations: Fade in a smooth vector field representing fluid flow. (Color: #FFFFFF)
Highlight a small region with circular flow. (Color: #FF00FF)
Animate tracer particles moving through the vector field. (Color: #00FFFF)

sections.title: Divergence: Source and Sink
lecture_lines: Divergence measures spreading at a point.
Positive divergence acts as a source.
Negative divergence acts as a sink.
animations: Display a point source where vectors point outward. (Color: #FF0000)
Display a point sink where vectors point inward. (Color: #0000FF)
Flash the divergence formula at the source/sink locations. (Color: #FFFF00)

sections.title: Curl: The Rotation Factor
animations: Show a paddle wheel in the vector field rotating. (Color: #00FF00)
Adjust vector field to increase local rotation magnitude. (Color: #00FF00)
Flash the curl formula near the rotating paddle. (Color: #FFCC00)

sections.title: Synthesis: The 'Nabla' Operator
lecture_lines: The del operator provides universal tools.
animations: Introduce the nabla symbol (∇) with scalar field. (Color: #FFFFFF)
Show nabla applied to the vector field (divergence). (Color: #FF0000)
Show nabla cross product with vector field (curl). (Color: #00FF00)
